description: The parse phase of `cargo xtask parity script`: every `.pas` of the `Edit Scripts` folder of the oracle (150 files, `xEditAPI.pas` included). The oracle compiles each script in its script mode (`-script:`, `DoRunScript` -> `ApplyScript` -> `TxeScriptHost.CreateScript`) and the run is classed by what its log and dialogs show: `done` (the mode posted its closing line), `aborted` (the script compiled and raised at runtime), `interactive` (a dialog of the script's own, which proves the compile: `Assets browser.pas` builds a `TForm`, `Bookmark.pas` shows its bookmark list from its main block, which `Compile` runs before `ApplyScript` posts the `Applying script` line) or `compile-error` (the application's own exception dialog: `Error in unit 'X' on line N : ...`, or an access violation when the compiler faults). The port answers with `xedit script check <file>` (exit 0 = parsed). The corpus runs one script at a time over an empty master the harness writes (a valid `TES4` record, no records): the module selection of the GUI forces the game master into every load, and compiling a script reads no record, so the parse phase needs no game data.

accept.xEditAPI.pas: the declaration-only API file: JvInterpreter 4.1.5q faults compiling it (an access violation in `InterpretConst` -> `Expression`, `JvInterpreter.pas:7426`/`:5877`, seen 2026-10-10), so the oracle cannot answer at all; the port's front end accepts the file and it declares no entry point, so `script run` does nothing with it. The variant the front end needed (type aliases, header directives, defaulted parameters) is recorded in the step 2 commit; the oracle's fault is not a behaviour a script can rely on.
